title: Starting a Technical Support Call
situation: Alex is at the airport and calls technical support because the baggage scanner is not ready. He gives the machine ID and location, spells the ID, waits while support checks the record, and closes the call politely.
objective: Start a support call, identify the machine and location, spell a machine ID, wait politely, and close the call.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Good morning, technical support. Sam speaking.
dialogue.indonesian: Selamat pagi, dukungan teknis. Saya Sam.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Good morning, Sam. This is Alex from the airport service team.
dialogue.indonesian: Selamat pagi, Sam. Ini Alex dari tim layanan bandara.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Hello, Alex. What can I do for you today?
dialogue.indonesian: Halo, Alex. Ada yang bisa saya bantu hari ini?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: I am calling about the baggage scanner on line two.
dialogue.indonesian: Saya menelepon soal pemindai bagasi di jalur dua.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Thank you. What is the machine ID?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: The machine ID is B-H-S seven-two.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Sorry, could you spell that for me?
dialogue.indonesian: Maaf, bisa Anda eja untuk saya?

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Yes. B, H, S, seven, two.
dialogue.indonesian: Baik. B, H, S, tujuh, dua.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Thank you. Please wait a moment while I check the record.
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih. Mohon tunggu sebentar sementara saya memeriksa catatannya.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Thank you for waiting. I found the machine record.
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih sudah menunggu. Saya menemukan catatan mesinnya.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Great. Can you help me with the startup problem?
dialogue.indonesian: Bagus. Bisakah Anda membantu saya dengan masalah saat menyalakan mesin?

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Yes. I will open a support ticket and send you the first step.
dialogue.indonesian: Tentu. Saya akan membuka tiket dukungan dan mengirimkan langkah pertamanya.

dialogue.speaker: Technician
dialogue.english: Thank you, Sam. I will wait for the ticket. Goodbye.
dialogue.indonesian: Terima kasih, Sam. Saya akan menunggu tiketnya. Selamat tinggal.

dialogue.speaker: Remote Engineer
dialogue.english: Goodbye, Alex. Have a good day.
dialogue.indonesian: Selamat tinggal, Alex. Semoga harimu menyenangkan.

keyExpressions.english: Good morning, technical support. Sam speaking.
keyExpressions.indonesian: Selamat pagi, dukungan teknis. Saya Sam.

keyExpressions.english: This is Alex from the airport service team.
keyExpressions.indonesian: Ini Alex dari tim layanan bandara.
keyExpressions.note: Gunakan This is ... untuk memperkenalkan diri di telepon.

keyExpressions.english: I am calling about the baggage scanner on line two.
keyExpressions.indonesian: Saya menelepon soal pemindai bagasi di jalur dua.
keyExpressions.note: Sebutkan mesin dan lokasinya di awal panggilan.

keyExpressions.english: The machine ID is B-H-S seven-two.
keyExpressions.note: Eja huruf dan angka dengan jelas.

keyExpressions.english: Please wait a moment while I check the record.
keyExpressions.indonesian: Mohon tunggu sebentar sementara saya memeriksa catatannya.

keyExpressions.english: I will open a support ticket and send you the first step.
keyExpressions.indonesian: Saya akan membuka tiket dukungan dan mengirimkan langkah pertamanya.

examples: This is Alex from the airport service team.
This is Sam from technical support.
I am calling about the baggage scanner on line two.
I am calling about a problem with the display.

sentencePatterns.explanation: Permintaan sopan, misalnya meminta seseorang mengeja.
examples: Could you spell that for me?
Could you check the machine record?

sentencePatterns.pattern: Please wait + time + while I + verb.
examples: Please wait a moment while I check the record.
Please wait a minute while I open the ticket.

learningNotes: Sebutkan nama, mesin, dan lokasi di awal panggilan agar lawan bicara cepat memahami situasi.
Saat mengeja ID, beri jeda singkat di antara huruf dan angka.
Tutup panggilan dengan mengulang tindakan berikutnya dan berterima kasih.

pronunciationNotes.title: scanner
pronunciationNotes.note: Tekanan ada di suku kata pertama: SKAN-ner (/ˈskænər/). Akhiran -er diucapkan ringan.

pronunciationNotes.title: technical
pronunciationNotes.note: Tekanan ada di suku kata pertama: TEK-ni-kal. Bunyi ch adalah /k/, bukan /tʃ/.
